disposition_reason: The ANSES TDS3 opinion (20 January 2026) reports metals only by food group; the only cocoa-relevant row is the mixed group 'Confectionery and chocolate' (12 samples) with Al, Cd, total Hg and Pb means. No chocolate-only or cocoa-powder value is printed; values extracted as mixed_products. ANSES also recommends further work on cocoa's contribution to cadmium exposure.

notes: Also in Table 4: acrylamide for the same group (not tracked). Silver (Ag) column not tracked. Methylmercury (Table 5) was not measured in confectionery/chocolate. Table 9: 'Confectionery and chocolate' is listed as a main contributor at 6% (C) in the column that aligns with aluminium (children). Recommendation (PDF p.22): 'undertaking additional work on the total contribution of cocoa to cadmium exposure' because international authorities focus on Cd in cocoa, although TDS3 did not find chocolate to be a major contributor to mean Cd exposure. No regulatory exceedances for Cd, total Hg or Pb in any sample.
contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary describes the group values correctly as confectionery-and-chocolate but routes the source to chocolate products/ingredients without flagging that values are not chocolate-specific.
unresolved: Composition of the 'Confectionery and chocolate' group (which TDS3 foods, share of chocolate) is not given in this opinion; it is in the ANSES 2024b methodological report, not available here.
Table 9 column alignment for the 6% (C) confectionery-and-chocolate contribution is read as aluminium from text layout; not independently verified from the PDF graphic.
Per-sample values and LOD/LOQ not published in this opinion.
